_comment: Single source of truth for all cloud/ repo dependencies. Read by build.sh deps + GHA setup-deps action.

system._comment: Keys = binary name checked on PATH. Values = package name per manager.

node._comment: Node packages required in c3-mcp-api/src/node_modules (engines runtime).

install._comment: nix_method: 'shell' = ephemeral nix-shell (CI/GHA), 'profile' = persistent nix profile install (local dev). auto_yes: skip all confirmations.
